title: Figures 26-27: GW beacon pairs (Earth-Moon for Mars; Earth-Mars for outer planets)
description: Two orbital geometry diagrams. Figure 26, "A GW Pair on Earth and on the Moon, as Used by a Mission to Mars", shows GW1 on the Moon and GW2 on Earth with lines to Mars, labeled "Rem = Earth to Mars Max range 1AU + 1.5 AU = 2.5 AU" and "θmax ~ Rlo / Rem rad ~ 60 mdeg". Figure 27, "A GW Pair on Earth and on Mars for an Outer Planetary Reference Pair", shows lines to Jupiter (~28 deg) and Saturn (~15 deg) with ranges 5.2 AU and 9.6 AU.
